reason: The multi-disciplinary assessment aligns with internal medicine pathophysiology: recurrent severe neutropenia and thrombocytopenia indicate profound bone marrow suppression from malignancy and therapy. Progressive dyspnea, hemoptysis, and staphylococcal infection reflect pulmonary compromise and immune failure. Multi-system toxicities and prolonged adverse events demonstrate high disease burden and limited reserve, accurately predicting high mortality risk.
